drawing: Low TV stand, overall 1468×420×502 (dimension lines on the iso view on p3: 1468 wide, 420 deep, 502 high). Sides 2/3 (390 deep × 486 high) reach the floor on adjustable feet G (2 per side, step 7); top 1 (1468×420) lies ON the sides (486+16=502), overhanging ~10 at each end; pilasters 4 (44×486) on the front edges of the sides with short dowels M. Bottom 5 (1416×390) spans between the sides, raised ~100 above the floor (486−370−16), so the sides stand as legs with a recess under the bottom. Partitions 6/7 (370×390) stand on the bottom 5 under the top, making three bays: side bays 381 wide (1416−2·16−622)/2 and a centre bay 622 wide. Bars 15 (381×80) under the top in the side bays (at the back, step view). Side bays closed by overlay doors 9 (386×386), 2 hinges K-16 per door on plates L mounted on the sides (step 7), knob I at the inner top corner of each door. Centre bay: shelf 8 (622×370) at about mid-height between the partitions (open niche above, no back behind it); drawer below it — front 10 (636×200, overlay, knob I at centre, fixed with R 4x12), sides 11/12 (350×160), back 13 (564×160), ДВП bottom 14 (592×355) screwed under (step 4, ~150 spacing), 1 pair ball runners J. Back ДВП: 16 (402×402) over each side bay, 17 (636×216) over the drawer part of the centre bay. No orthographic front view (p1 and p3 are isometric).
